name: Browser automation
blurb: Drive Chrome or Playwright with typed decisions
description: Agents that click, type and navigate real pages. Jev selects the action and the target element, while the surrounding code executes it and verifies the result.

name: Computer & desktop use
blurb: Control apps, screens and the mouse
description: Desktop automation projects that read the screen or accessibility tree and act on native applications. Jev decides the next action and target.

name: Agent routing & tool choice
blurb: Pick the next tool, model or branch
description: Routers and orchestrators that choose between tools, models, agents or workflow branches. Jev returns a typed choice instead of a sentence.

name: Classification & labelling
description: Classifiers for support tickets, documents, content and user intent. Jev returns a label and a confidence instead of generated text.

name: Reranking & relevance
description: Projects that score passages, memories or candidates for relevance before an LLM reads them. Score and Noul answers replace generated judgements.

name: RAG & retrieval
blurb: Ground answers in your own data
description: Retrieval, memory and knowledge-base projects with an optional Jev filtering or scoring step. Jev evaluates passages before the answer is written.

name: Evaluation & benchmarks
description: Evaluation harnesses, benchmarks and graders. Jev scores or chooses between candidate outputs with an explicit rubric.

name: Guardrails & safety
description: Permission checks, moderation and safety filters for agents. Jev answers an explicit policy question before the action runs.

name: Coding agents & review
blurb: Review diffs, plans and tool calls
description: Coding assistants, IDE plugins and review tools that use Jev to gate edits, choose the next step or judge a diff.

name: Data extraction & documents
description: Scrapers, OCR pipelines and document processors. Jev classifies fields or decides whether an extraction is usable.

name: Trading & finance
description: Trading bots, research desks and portfolio tools that use Jev for entry, risk or allocation decisions.

name: Games & simulations
blurb: Policies and judges for game agents
description: Games, sandboxes and simulations where Jev chooses moves, evaluates outcomes or judges generated content.

name: Local & offline models
blurb: Run decision models on your own hardware
description: Local alternatives and on-device decision models that follow the System One interface, plus shims for existing Jev clients.

name: SDKs & framework integration
blurb: Call Jev from your language or framework
description: Client libraries, framework adapters and plugins that expose Jev inside an existing stack.

name: Content & writing
blurb: Plan, judge and improve generated content
description: Writing assistants and content pipelines that use Jev to choose an outline, score a draft or classify a document.

name: Support & conversation
description: Support desks, chat assistants and CRM tools that use Jev for intent, routing or response selection.

name: Workflow automation
description: Workflow engines, schedulers and batch jobs that use Jev to choose a branch, retry or escalation step.

name: Observability & ops
description: Tracing, logging and incident tooling with an optional Jev classification or triage step.

name: Science & health
description: Scientific and clinical projects that use Jev for screening, labelling or deciding the next experiment.

name: Search & discovery
description: Search front ends, indexes and recommenders that use Jev to rank or filter results.
